s13.byYou: ដោយអ្នក: អ្នកអាចលុបគណនីរបស់អ្នកនៅពេលណាក៏បាន តាមរយៈការកំណត់ប្រវត្តិរូបរបស់អ្នក។ បន្ទាប់ពីការលុប ទិន្នន័យរបស់អ្នកនឹងត្រូវបានដោះស្រាយដូចបានពិពណ៌នានៅក្នុងគោលការណ៍ភាពឯកជន
s13.byUs: ដោយយើង: យើងរក្សាសិទ្ធិក្នុងការផ្អាក ឬបញ្ចប់គណនីរបស់អ្នកនៅពេលណាក៏បាន ជាមួយ ឬគ្មានការជូនដំណឹង ដោយសារហេតុផលណាមួយខាងក្រោម:

ភាពដល់ជើងម្ខាងយូរ
កាតព្វកិច្ចផ្លូវច្បាប់ ឬតម្រូវការបទប្បញ្ញត្តិ
s13.note: នៅពេលបញ្ចប់ សិទ្ធិរបស់អ្នកក្នុងការចូលប្រើវេទិកាបញ្ចប់ភ្លាមៗ។ បទប្បញ្ញត្តិនៃលក្ខខណ្ឌទាំងនេះ ដែលតាមធម្មជាតិគួរតែរស់រានក្រោយការបញ្ចប់ នឹងនៅតែมีeffect

s14.title: ច្បាប់គ្រប់គ្រង
s14.p1strong: ព្រះរាជាណាចក្រកម្ពុជា
s14.p1: ដោយគ្មានការពិចារណាចំពោះគោលការណ៍ជម្លោះច្បាប់
s14.p1prefix: លក្ខខណ្ឌនៃការប្រើប្រាស់ទាំងនេះត្រូវបានគ្រប់គ្រង និងបកស្រាយស្របតាមច្បាប់នៃ
s14.p2: វិវាទណាមួយដែលបណ្តាល ឬទាក់ទងនឹងលក្ខខណ្ឌទាំងនេះ ឬការប្រើប្រាស់ Apsara Talent របស់អ្នក នឹងស្ថិតក្រោម Jurisdiction ផ្តាច់មុខនៃតុលាការដែលមានសមត្ថកិច្ចនៃភ្នំពេញ ប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។ អ្នកលះបង់ការជំទាស់ណាមួយចំពោះ Jurisdiction ឬទីកន្លែងនៃតុលាការបែបនេះ

s15.title: ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរលក្ខខណ្ឌ
s15.p1: យើងអាចកែប្រែលក្ខខណ្ឌនៃការប្រើប្រាស់ទាំងនេះនៅពេលណាក៏បាន។ យើងនឹងផ្តល់ការជូនដំណឹងអំពីការផ្លាស់ប្តូរសំខាន់ដោយធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពកាលបរិច្ឆេទ "ធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពចុងក្រោយ" ហើយទីកន្លែងដែលសមស្រប ជូនដំណឹងដល់អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ដែលបានចុះឈ្មោះតាមអ៊ីមែល ឬការជូនដំណឹងក្នុងកម្មវិធី
s15.p2: ការប្រើប្រាស់ Apsara Talent ជានិច្ចរបស់អ្នកក្រោយពេលមានប្រសិទ្ធភាពនៃលក្ខខណ្ឌដែលបានធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាព ស្មើនឹងការទទួលស្គាល់ការផ្លាស់ប្តូររបស់អ្នក។ ប្រសិនបើអ្នកមិនយល់ព្រមនឹងលក្ខខណ្ឌដែលបានធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាព អ្នកត្រូវឈប់ប្រើប្រាស់វេទិកា ហើយលុបគណនីរបស់អ្នក

en.intro: At Apsara Talent, we are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we use and safeguard it when you use our talent-matching platform.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.intro: We collect information you provide directly, information generated by your use of the platform, and information from third-party services you connect.
g1: Full name, username, email address, and phone number
Profile photo / avatar and, for companies, a cover image
Password (stored as a secure hash — we never store it in plain text)
Social login identifiers from Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, or GitHub when you choose those sign-in methods
g2: Job title, years of experience, availability type, and career scopes
Skills, work experience history, and educational background
Resume and cover letter files you upload
Social profile links (LinkedIn, GitHub, website, etc.)
g3: Company name, industry, size, founded year, and description
Open job positions, available interview times, and company values/benefits
g4: Pages visited, features used, and interactions within the platform
Chat messages exchanged between users on the platform
Favorites and matching actions (saves, likes, swipes)
Push notification device token for delivering notifications
Last login time, login method, and IP address
Browser type, operating system, and device identifiers

s2.title: How We Use Your Information
bullets: To create, verify, and maintain your account
To power the talent-matching algorithm that surfaces relevant employees to companies and vice versa
To enable real-time messaging between matched users
To send push notifications about new matches, messages, and platform updates
To generate AI-assisted resume drafts via the Resume Builder feature
To personalise your feed and search results based on your profile and activity
To detect fraud, enforce our Terms of Service, and maintain platform security
To send transactional emails such as email verification, password reset, and account activity alerts
To improve and develop new features through aggregated, anonymised analytics
s2.note: We do not sell your personal data to third parties or use it for unrelated advertising purposes.
s2.noteSuffix: sell your personal data to third parties or use it for unrelated advertising purposes.

s3.title: How We Share Your Information
s3.intro: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We share information only in the following limited circumstances:

bullets.label: With other users:
bullets.text: Your public profile (name, job, skills, location, availability, description) is visible to the other user type — employees can be seen by companies and companies can be seen by employees — to facilitate matching and hiring.

bullets.label: With service providers:
bullets.text: We use trusted infrastructure providers (cloud hosting, database, email delivery) who process data on our behalf under strict data processing agreements.

bullets.label: With social login providers:
bullets.text: When you authenticate via Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, or GitHub, those services receive information according to their own privacy policies.

bullets.label: For legal compliance:
bullets.text: We may disclose data when required by Cambodian law, court orders, or to protect the rights and safety of our users.

bullets.label: During business transfers:
bullets.text: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your data may be transferred to the successor entity.

s4.title: Third-Party Services
s4.intro: Apsara Talent integrates the following third-party services. Each has its own privacy policy that governs their use of your data:

bullets.label: Google Firebase:
bullets.text: Used for push notification delivery (Firebase Cloud Messaging). Your device token is stored securely and used solely for notifications.

bullets.label: Google OAuth / Google Sign-In:
bullets.text: Optional authentication method. We receive your name, email, and profile picture from Google if you choose this option.

bullets.label: Facebook Login:
bullets.text: Optional authentication method governed by Meta's Data Policy.

bullets.label: LinkedIn OAuth:
bullets.text: Optional authentication for professional identity verification.

bullets.label: GitHub OAuth:
bullets.text: Optional authentication for technical professionals.

bullets.label: Cloud Infrastructure (Railway):
bullets.text: Our API and database are hosted on Railway. Data is processed in secure, industry-standard data centers.

s5.title: Data Retention
s5.intro: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with our services.
bullets: Account data is retained for the lifetime of your account.
Chat messages are stored to provide a persistent messaging history. You may delete individual conversations.
After account deletion, we retain certain data for up to 30 days before permanent erasure to allow for account recovery, except where longer retention is required by law.
Anonymised, aggregated analytics data may be retained indefinitely as it cannot be linked to any individual.

s6.title: Security
s6.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
bullets: All data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS encryption.
Passwords are hashed using a strong one-way algorithm and are never stored in plain text.
Optional Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is available to add an extra layer of account security.
Access to personal data is restricted to authorised personnel only.
We perform regular security reviews of our infrastructure.
s6.note: While we take every reasonable precaution, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We encourage you to use a strong, unique password and enable 2FA.

s7.title: Your Rights
s7.intro: You have the following rights with respect to your personal data:

bullets.label: Access:
bullets.text: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

bullets.label: Correction:
bullets.text: Update or correct inaccurate information via your profile settings at any time.

bullets.label: Deletion:
bullets.text: Request deletion of your account and personal data.

bullets.label: Portability:
bullets.text: Request an export of your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

bullets.label: Objection:
bullets.text: Object to the processing of your data for specific purposes.

bullets.label: Withdraw Consent:
bullets.text: Withdraw consent for optional data processing at any time without affecting prior processing.

s7.note: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at

s8.title: Cookies & Local Storage
s8.intro: We use browser cookies and local storage to:
bullets: Maintain your authentication session securely.
Remember your theme preference (light / dark / system).
Remember your language preference (English / ភាសាខ្មែរ).
Store cached data locally to improve page load performance.
s8.note: We do not use third-party advertising cookies. You can clear cookies and local storage via your browser settings at any time, though this will sign you out of your account.

s9.title: Children's Privacy
s9.text: Apsara Talent is intended for users who are 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under 18. If we become aware that a user is under 18, we will promptly delete their account and associated data. If you believe a minor has registered an account, please contact us immediately.

s10.title: Changes to This Policy
s10.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make material changes, we will:
bullets: Update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
Send a notification to registered users via email or in-app notification.
s10.note: Your continued use of Apsara Talent after the effective date of the updated policy constitutes your acceptance of the changes.

s3.title: របៀបដែលយើងចែករំលែកព័ត៌មានរបស់អ្នក

bullets.label: ជាមួយអ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ផ្សេង:
bullets.text: ប្រវត្តិរូបសាធារណៈរបស់អ្នក (ឈ្មោះ ការងារ ជំនាញ ទីតាំង ភាពទំនេរ ការពិពណ៌នា) អាចមើលឃើញដោយប្រភេទអ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ម្ខាងទៀត — និយោជិតអាចត្រូវបានក្រុមហ៊ុនមើលឃើញ ហើយក្រុមហ៊ុនអាចត្រូវបានគេមើលឃើញដោយនិយោជិត — ដើម្បីជួយឱ្យការផ្គូផ្គង និងការជ្រើសរើសសម្ភារៈ

bullets.label: ជាមួយអ្នកផ្តល់សេវា:
bullets.text: យើងប្រើអ្នកផ្តល់ហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធទំុកទុក (ហ៊ីបឌ័រ ទិន្នន័យ ការផ្ញើអ៊ីមែល) ដែលដំណើរការទិន្នន័យក្នុងនាមមយ្យួើងក្រោមកិច្ចព្រមព្រៀងដំណើរការទិន្នន័យយ៉ាងតឹងរ៉ឹង

bullets.label: ជាមួយអ្នកផ្តល់ Social Login:

s5.title: ការរក្សាទុកទិន្នន័យ

s6.title: សុវត្ថិភាព
s6.intro: យើងអនុវត្តវិធានការសុវត្ថិភាពស្ដង់ដារឧស្សាហកម្មដើម្បីការពារទិន្នន័យរបស់អ្នក:
bullets: ទិន្នន័យទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានបញ្ជូនតាមការអ៊ិនគ្រីប HTTPS/TLS
ពាក្យសម្ងាត់ត្រូវបាន hash ដោយប្រើក្បួន one-way ខ្លាំង ហើយមិនរក្សាទុកជាអក្សរធម្មតាឡើយ
ការផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ Two-Factor (2FA) ជាជម្រើស ដើម្បីបន្ថែមស្រទាប់ការការពារគណនីបន្ថែម
ការចូលប្រើទិន្នន័យផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនត្រូវបានកំណត់ចំពោះបុគ្គលិកដែលមានការអនុញ្ញាតប៉ុណ្ណោះ
យើងធ្វើការពិនិត្យសុវត្ថិភាពឱ្យបានទៀងទាត់នៃហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធរបស់យើង
s6.note: ខណៈដែលយើងប្រុងប្រយ័ត្នគ្រប់ការ មិនមានវិធីណាមួយនៃការបញ្ជូនតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតដែល ១០០% សុវត្ថិភាពទេ។ យើងលើកទឹកចិត្តឱ្យអ្នកប្រើពាក្យសម្ងាត់ខ្លាំង ពិសេស និងបើក 2FA។

s7.title: សិទ្ធិរបស់អ្នក

bullets.label: ការចូលប្រើ:
bullets.text: ស្នើសុំច្បាប់ចម្លងនៃទិន្នន័យផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនដែលយើងកាន់អំពីអ្នក

bullets.label: ការកែតម្រូវ:

bullets.label: ការលុប:
bullets.text: ស្នើសុំការលុបគណនី និងទិន្នន័យផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់អ្នក

bullets.label: ការផ្ទេរ:

bullets.label: ការជំទាស់:
bullets.text: ជំទាស់ការដំណើរការទិន្នន័យរបស់អ្នកសម្រាប់គោលបំណងជាក់លាក់

bullets.label: ដក​ការ​យល់ព្រម:
bullets.text: ដក​ការ​យល់ព្រម​សម្រាប់​ការ​ដំណើរ​ការ​ទិន្នន័យ​ជា​ជម្រើស​នៅ​ពេល​ណា​ក​ដោយ​មិន​ប៉ះ​ពាល់​ការ​ដំណើរ​ការ​ពី​មុន

s7.note: ដើម្បីប្រើសិទ្ធិទាំងនេះ សូមទាក់ទងពួកយើងនៅ

s8.title: ខូគី និងការផ្ទុកក្នុងស្រុក
s8.intro: យើងប្រើខូគីកម្មវិធីរុករក និងការផ្ទុកក្នុងស្រុកដើម្បី:
bullets: រក្សាការចូលប្រើ Session របស់អ្នកដោយសុវត្ថិភាព
ចងចាំចំណូលចិត្ត Theme (ភ្លឺ / ងងឹត / ប្រព័ន្ធ) របស់អ្នក
ចងចាំចំណូលចិត្តភាសា (ភាសាអង់គ្លេស / ភាសាខ្មែរ) របស់អ្នក
រក្សាទុកទិន្នន័យ Cache ក្នុងស្រុក ដើម្បីធ្វើឱ្យប្រសើរ Performance ការផ្ទុកទំព័រ
s8.note: យើងមិនប្រើខូគីផ្សាយពាណិជ្ជកម្មភាគីទីបីឡើយ។ អ្នកអាចលុបខូគី និងការផ្ទុកក្នុងស្រុកតាមការកំណត់ Browser របស់អ្នកនៅពេលណាក៏បាន ទោះជាក្តី វានឹងធ្វើឱ្យអ្នកចេញពីគណនី។

s9.title: ភាពឯកជនរបស់កុមារ
s9.text: Apsara Talent ត្រូវបានរចនាសម្រាប់អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ដែលមានអាយុ ១៨ ឆ្នាំ ឬលើសពីនេះ។ យើងមិនប្រមូលព័ត៌មានផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនពីបុគ្គលដែលមានអាយុក្រោម ១៨ ឆ្នាំដោយចេតនាឡើយ។ ប្រសិនបើយើងដឹងថាអ្នកប្រើប្រាស់មានអាយុក្រោម ១៨ ឆ្នាំ យើងនឹងលុបគណនី និងទិន្នន័យដែលពាក់ព័ន្ធរបស់ពួកគេឱ្យបានឆាប់រហ័ស។ ប្រសិនបើអ្នកជឿថាកុមារម្នាក់បានចុះឈ្មោះ សូមទាក់ទងពួកយើងភ្លាម។

s10.title: ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរគោលការណ៍នេះ
s10.intro: យើងអាចធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពគោលការណ៍ភាពឯកជននេះពីពេលទៅពេល ដើម្បីឆ្លុះបញ្ចាំងការផ្លាស់ប្តូរនៅក្នុងការអនុវត្ត បច្ចេកវិទ្យា តម្រូវការច្បាប់ ឬកត្តាផ្សេងៗ។ នៅពេលយើងធ្វើការផ្លាស់ប្តូរសំខាន់ យើងនឹង:
bullets: ធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពកាលបរិច្ឆេទ "ធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពចុងក្រោយ" នៅផ្នែកខាងលើទំព័រនេះ
ផ្ញើការជូនដំណឹងដល់អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់ដែលចុះឈ្មោះតាមអ៊ីមែល ឬការជូនដំណឹងក្នុងកម្មវិធី
s10.note: ការប្រើប្រាស់ Apsara Talent ជានិច្ចរបស់អ្នកក្រោយពេលមានប្រសិទ្ធភាពនៃគោលការណ៍ដែលបានធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាព ស្មើនឹងការទទួលស្គាល់ការផ្លាស់ប្តូររបស់អ្នក។

s11.title: ទំនាក់ទំនងពួកយើង

en.subtitle: Your safety is our priority. Learn about the measures we take to protect your data, identity, and experience on Apsara Talent.
en.commitmentIntro: At Apsara Talent, we believe everyone deserves a safe and respectful environment. Our platform is built with multiple layers of protection to ensure your experience is secure.
commitmentBullets: Zero tolerance policy for harassment, fraud, and discriminatory behavior
Continuous monitoring and proactive threat detection across the platform
Dedicated safety team reviewing reports and enforcing community guidelines
Regular security audits and penetration testing by independent experts
Compliance with international data protection standards
en.dataIntro: We use industry-standard security practices to protect your personal information across all Apsara Talent products — web, mobile, and AI assistant.
dataBullets: End-to-end encryption for all messages and sensitive data in transit
AES-256 encryption for data at rest in our secure cloud infrastructure
JWT-based authentication with short-lived tokens and secure refresh mechanisms
Role-based access control ensuring users only access what they are authorized to see
Automated backup and disaster recovery systems to prevent data loss
SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise-grade security assurance
en.privacyIntro: You are in control of your data. Apsara Talent provides granular privacy settings so you decide who sees your information.
privacyBullets: Control profile visibility — choose who can view your profile and contact you
Manage data sharing preferences for matching and recommendations
Download or delete your data at any time through your account settings
Opt out of analytics and tracking with a single toggle
Transparent cookie policy with user consent management
en.identityIntro: We work to ensure that every user on the platform is who they claim to be, creating a trustworthy environment for both job seekers and employers.
identityBullets: Email verification required for all accounts
Social login verification through trusted providers (Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, GitHub)
Company verification process for employer accounts to prevent impersonation
Suspicious activity detection and automatic account protection
Two-factor authentication available for enhanced account security
en.reportingIntro: If something does not feel right, we make it easy to report issues and take swift action to protect the community.
reportingBullets: One-tap reporting for inappropriate content, messages, or profiles
Dedicated moderation team that reviews reports within 24 hours
Automatic content filtering to block spam, scams, and harmful material
User blocking and muting tools for personal safety
Transparent enforcement actions with clear appeal processes
en.aiSafetyIntro: The Apsara Agentic AI Assistant is built with safety guardrails to ensure fair, unbiased, and transparent recommendations.
aiSafetyBullets: Bias detection and mitigation in matching algorithms to ensure fair treatment
Human oversight on all AI-driven decisions — AI recommends, humans decide
Transparent reasoning — every AI suggestion includes an explanation
No use of protected characteristics (race, gender, religion) in matching decisions
Regular fairness audits and model evaluations to prevent algorithmic harm
User feedback loops to continuously improve AI accuracy and safety
en.aiSafetyNote: Our AI systems are designed to assist and augment human judgment, never to make autonomous decisions about people’s careers or opportunities.

en.subtitle: Need help? Find answers to common questions, get in touch with our team, or explore resources to resolve any issues.
en.faqIntro: Quick answers to the most common questions about Apsara Talent.

faqs.q: How do I create an account?
faqs.a: You can sign up using your email, or through social login with Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, or GitHub. Visit the Sign Up page to get started.

faqs.q: Is Apsara Talent free to use?
faqs.a: Yes! Creating a profile, browsing jobs, and using basic matching features are completely free for job seekers. Employers can post jobs and access standard features at no cost.

faqs.q: How does the AI matching work?
faqs.a: Our Apsara Agentic AI Assistant analyzes your skills, experience, preferences, and behavior patterns to suggest the most compatible matches. The more complete your profile, the better the recommendations.

faqs.q: Is my data safe on the platform?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption, AES-256 for data at rest, and JWT-based authentication. Visit our Safety page to learn more about our security practices.

faqs.q: How do I reset my password?
faqs.a: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. We will send a verification code to your registered email. Follow the instructions to set a new password.

faqs.q: Can I use Apsara Talent on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes! Our mobile app is available on both iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). You get full access to matching, messaging, profile management, and push notifications.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account?
faqs.a: Go to Settings in your account and select 'Delete Account'. You can also download your data before deletion. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

faqs.q: What is the Apsara Agentic AI Assistant?
faqs.a: It is an intelligent AI companion built into the platform that helps with matching, resume building, interview preparation, and provides personalized career insights. It augments human decision-making without replacing it.
